description: Unit tests for the TrieBitBuffer class in the Huffman trie implementation, testing bit writing, position encoding, Huffman character encoding, and mixed write operations.

methods.name: WriteBit
methods.description: Test writing individual bits to the buffer and verifying the output.

methods.name: WriteBits
methods.description: Test writing multiple bits at once and verifying byte boundaries.

methods.name: WritePosition
methods.description: Test writing position deltas and verifying the encoded positions.

methods.name: WriteChar
methods.description: Test writing characters with Huffman encoding and verifying the output.

methods.name: WriteMix
methods.description: Test writing a mix of bits, characters, and positions, verifying correct order and byte boundaries.
